### 3. Global font tokens — this is the reusable mechanism

Defined once, at the very top of `marketplace/plugin/sutra-ui/static/panel.css` (lines 1–3):
```css
:root{--serif:ui-serif,"Iowan Old Style","Palatino Linotype",Palatino,Georgia,serif;
  --sans:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
  --mono:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;--r:10px}
```
- `body{ font-family:var(--sans); }` (panel.css line 35) is the app-wide default the Shadow screen inherits.
- `--serif` is used for headings/greetings app-wide (`.mast h1`, `.insp h4`, `.zero h4`, `.dpage h1`, `.onb-card h1`, etc.).
- `--mono` is used for code/telemetry (`code{}`, `.num`, `.att .attn`, etc.).
- `workspace.css` documents the same three-token contract explicitly at lines 44–46 as a comment:
  ```
  mock --font-display -> var(--serif)   charter-page h1
  mock --font-body    -> var(--sans)    everything else
  mock --font-mono    -> var(--mono)    (document body lives in the sidecar iframe)
  ```
- `static/js/10-activity.js` (lines 77, 105) and `static/js/03-org.js`/`05-chat.js` inject inline `style="font-family:var(--serif|--sans|--mono)"` per element — i.e. per-element font selection **from the fixed three-token palette** is already a normal pattern in this codebase, it's just always one of `--serif`/`--sans`/`--mono`, never a user-chosen family.

Any of these resizes the terminal and re-breaks rendering.") — a real constraint if a font picker were ever meant to be global.

### 4. Existing settings/config mechanism to model a font picker after — **the accent-color picker**

There is **no existing per-view font configuration** anywhere (no settings.json field, no font picker UI, no `--font-family`-style user-overridable CSS var). The closest, and best, existing pattern to imitate is the **global accent color picker**, in `marketplace/plugin/sutra-ui/static/js/07-loaders.js`:

- Theme (light/dark) toggle, lines 994–1010: reads/writes `localStorage["sutra.panel.theme"]`, sets `data-theme` attribute on `<html>` (`r.setAttribute("data-theme", n)`), which `panel.css` `:root,[data-theme="dark"]` / `@media (prefers-color-scheme:light)` blocks key off (panel.css lines 4, 14).
- Accent color, lines 1121–1179 (`applyAccent`, `buildAccentRow`): a small fixed swatch list `ACCENTS` (line 1149), stored in `localStorage["sutra.panel.accent"]` (`ACCENT_KEY`, line 1148), applied via **inline CSS custom properties set on `document.documentElement`**:
  ```js
  r.style.setProperty("--acc", hex);
  r.style.setProperty("--on-acc", on);
  r.setAttribute("data-accent", hex);
  ```
  `panel.css` then derives `--acc-bg` per theme from that attribute (lines 139–142). The picker UI itself is a `<div class="swrow" id="accentRow">` inside the identity menu in `static/panel.html` (lines 38–42), populated by `buildAccentRow()`.

This is **entirely client-side, global (not per-view), and localStorage-persisted** — there is no server-side settings.json entry for it and no per-screen override capability built into the SCREENS/render architecture. `SCREENS.settings` (`static/js/05-chat.js` line 481) reads a server-provided `SETTINGS` object from `/api/settings`, but that covers CLI provider selection and permission mode only — nothing about typography.

### Bottom line for your task

"Support a different font" for the shadow-instructions panel is currently **a new capability**, not an existing one to expose:
- No per-view font setting exists anywhere in `sutra-ui`.
- The only configurable *visual* tokens today are theme (light/dark) and accent color, both global-only, both implemented as `localStorage` + inline `style.setProperty`/`data-*` attribute on `<html>`, consumed by CSS custom properties in `panel.css`.
- If you want per-view font support, the accent-color mechanism (lines 1121–1179 of `07-loaders.js`, plus the `data-accent`/`:root[data-accent]` pattern in `panel.css`) is the idiomatic template to copy: e.g. add a `data-shadow-font` attribute (or a new `--font-shadow` custom property scoped under `.shhome`) toggled from a small picker UI, defaulting to `var(--sans)`, persisted to `localStorage`. The render target for the font would be `.shmem`/`.shmemtext`/`.shthread` rules in `panel.css` (lines 1922, 1930–1936), since those currently have no explicit `font-family` and simply inherit the app-wide `--sans`.</result>
